ordinary_timing.scope: Estimate only. Host time ends before the final timing synchronization. CUDA event elapsed time can include idle gaps.

mfu.scope: Analytic FLOPs divided by the ordinary CUDA event median and L40S dense BF16 peak. Excludes apply, optimizer, and data. Hardware utilization was not measured.

synchronized_phase_timing.scope: One separate estimate. CUDA synchronization at phase boundaries changes execution.

error.message: Non-finite clean loss in profile estimate
